claim: All nutraceutical products must obtain an FSSAI license before manufacture or sale in India, including online sales — selling without an FSSAI license online is illegal.
stance_target: FSSAI licensing is mandatory for all channels including Amazon India
quoted_support: Is it possible to sell nutraceutical products online without the FSSAI license? No, it is not legal to sell without an FSSAI license, online and offline.

claim: FSSAI requires nutraceutical products to undergo stability testing, microbiological testing, heavy metal testing, and shelf-life studies as mandatory quality testing requirements.
stance_target: Genuine FSSAI compliance involves product testing, not just a license number
scope_conditions: India, FSSAI nutraceutical quality testing requirements
quoted_support: Testing is very important in the quality control of products. Types of Testing Required: Stability testing, Microbiological testing, Heavy metal testing, Shelf-life studies.

claim: Prohibited nutraceutical label claims include 'cures diseases', 'prevention of COVID or chronic diseases', and any unsubstantiated treatment claims.
stance_target: FSSAI explicitly lists COVID and chronic disease prevention as prohibited claims on supplements
quoted_support: Prohibited Claims: 'Cures diseases', 'Prevention of COVID or chronic diseases', Any unsubstantiated treatment claims.
